_readme: Shared contract for split_at_ellipses and for how verify_quotes locates a quote that is not in the paper whole but holds an ellipsis. bmlib's Python (tests/test_quote_pieces_contract.py) and Rust (rust/bmlib/tests/quote_pieces_contract.rs) assert against this file. Expected values are hand-written (offsets by str.find on the text), never generated by the code under test. Offsets are Unicode code-point indices. Every piece must be located and have at least min_piece_words words; a contradicted piece makes the quote contradicted (reason as PassageContradiction's value).
